End-to-end application delivery

Because this platform’s specific capabilities are not identified, the walkthrough below shows the standard delivery lifecycle. Complexity affects the depth of governance, architecture, testing, security, and release controls at each stage.

Diagram
flowchart TD
    A[Capture idea and business outcome] --> B[Discover users and requirements]
    B --> C[Classify complexity risk and scale]
    C --> D[Define scope and acceptance criteria]
    D --> E[Design user experience architecture and data]
    E --> F[Review security privacy and compliance]
    F --> G[Create backlog and delivery increments]
    G --> H[Configure environments and delivery pipeline]
    H --> I[Build application and integrations]
    I --> J[Run automated code and security checks]
    J --> K[Deploy to test environment]
    K --> L[Functional integration performance and accessibility testing]
    L --> M{Quality criteria met}
    M -- No --> I
    M -- Yes --> N[User acceptance testing]
    N --> O{Business approval granted}
    O -- No --> G
    O -- Yes --> P[Prepare release migration rollback and support]
    P --> Q[Production approval]
    Q --> R[Deploy progressively to production]
    R --> S[Validate health data and user journeys]
    S --> T{Release healthy}
    T -- No --> U[Rollback or remediate]
    U --> I
    T -- Yes --> V[Operate monitor and support]
    V --> W[Measure outcomes and collect feedback]
    W --> X[Prioritize improvements]
    X --> G
    V --> Y[Retire application when appropriate]
    Y --> Z[Archive or migrate data and remove access]
